column1: # p378 — THE INSTRUMENT THIS PASS CHOSE OVER p377's CRUDER METHOD IS BLIND TO ONE ADDRESS
# CHANNEL, AND THE BLINDNESS FLIPPED A PRE-REGISTERED LIMB FROM CONFIRMED TO REFUTED.
# This file is this pass's own error, published rather than tidied, and it is the most useful
# thing the pass found.
# WHAT THIS PASS COMMITTED TO, in evidence/agentleg-language-dispersion-prediction.2026-10-22-p378.tsv,
# before any leg ran:
#   "unit_of_measurement: ADDRESSES (owner/repo), CARRIED/NEW graded by `make carried SLUG=...`
#    — the p235 instrument ITSELF, NOT by hand.  p377 could not run it (its sandbox refused to
#    execute repository code); this pass can, and the grade is therefore instrument-derived
#    rather than index-eyeballed."
# 🔴 THE ERROR.  `make carried` graded `msitarzewski/agency-agents` NEW.  It is not new.  It
# sits on `repos/trending.md:21457` and has since an earlier pass:
#   | `msitarzewski/agency-agents` | agent scaffolding | 🔴 **Horizontal**, not education |
# 🔴 THE CAUSE, read from the instrument's own source rather than inferred.
# compose/code/p235-carried-index/carried_index.py:28
#   SLUG = re.compile(r"github\.com/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)")
# The harvester matches the URL channel ONLY.  A BARE BACKTICKED SLUG carries no `github.com/`
# prefix, so it is invisible to `make carried` — and the shelves write both channels.
# 🔵 THIS IS p367's CHANNEL-B BLINDNESS, in the CARRIED instrument rather than in the census.
# p367 found 496 live repositories — 16.3 % of the true corpus — that no census here could see,
# because every census read channel U (URLs) and the shelves also write channel B (bare
# backticked slugs).  p375 built the union census for the census side.  🔴 NOBODY CHECKED THE
# CARRIED INDEX, and `make carried` is the instrument a pass runs immediately BEFORE publishing
# a row — so its false-NEW class is the one that actually puts a duplicate on a shelf.
# 🔴 AND THE UNCOMFORTABLE PART: p377's METHOD WAS BETTER THAN THIS PASS'S INSTRUMENT.
# p377 could not run `make carried` and graded CARRIED/NEW by "case-insensitive index over the
# nine SHELF_FILES" — raw text, both channels, no regex.  That cruder method WOULD have caught
# msitarzewski.  🔵 This pass replaced it with the real instrument, called that an improvement
# in its own pre-registration, and lost a true CARRIED by doing so.  An instrument is not
# better than a grep because it is an instrument.
